## `/plan 1 --yes` — AMENDS mode

**Derivation:** Bare id `1` → Story #1 is `agent::done` (CLOSED) → **amending**. Planned from the delta envelope (prior body, its 16 acceptance criteria, delivered file map) rather than re-interrogating the repo.

**Grounding:** Read the delivered code the amendment touches — the access model is currently strictly owner-scoped (`getProject(db, ownerId, projectId)` and the `ownedProject` gate resolve every non-owner request as 404), and the schema lives solely in `src/store/migrations/`.

**Result:** One cohesive delta Story persisted → **[#3 "Share projects with viewer/editor roles"](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-08-07-epic-scope-mandrel-32529600/issues/3)**, `agent::ready`, label `plan-run::d5d270b5`.

### What the Story specifies
- **Schema:** new migration `002_shares.js` → `project_shares(project_id, user_id, role)` with `UNIQUE(project_id, user_id)`, `role ∈ {viewer, editor}`, cascade-on-delete; registered so `runMigrations` stays idempotent.
- **Access contract:** effective role resolved as owner / editor / viewer / none — owner-only for delete-project and share; editor adds task create/update/delete; viewer is read-only; **none → 404 (existence never revealed)**. Authorized-but-over-role → 403; no-relationship → 404.
- **Endpoint:** `POST /projects/:id/shares` `{userId, role}` — owner 201, shared non-owner 403, unrelated 404; bad role → 400, unknown user → 404.
- **Confined to the API unit + store schema** — worker and admin CLI explicitly untouched (in Non-Goals).

### Gates & decisions (headless `--yes`)
- **Gate #1** (intent) and **Gate #2** (review) auto-proceeded — no operator present.
- **Critics:** consolidation & pre-mortem both `dispatch: false`; text-hygiene clean — no re-author round.
- **Dry-run** clean before the real persist; one **advisory** `spec-word-budget` note (~422 vs 350-word soft budget), non-gating.
- **Decisions-made-by-default** recorded in the Spec: (1) exports stay owner-scoped, (2) `GET /projects` includes shared projects so viewers can discover the id (widens #1's AC-7), (3) re-sharing a user upserts their role.

No delivery run and no artifacts staged, per instructions. Ready for `/deliver 3` when you choose.

## Summary

**`/deliver 3 --yes`** — one Story, `inline` dispatch (single-Story run), delivered end-to-end and **merged to `main` via PR #4**, Story #3 flipped to `agent::done`.

**What shipped** (project sharing, confined to the API unit + store schema):
- **Migration `002_shares.js`** — `project_shares` table: `UNIQUE(project_id, user_id)`, `role CHECK IN ('viewer','editor')`, `ON DELETE CASCADE` to `projects`. Registered in the migration registry; `npm run migrate` twice stays idempotent (exit 0).
- **Store** — an `effectiveRole(db, userId, projectId)` resolver (`owner`|`editor`|`viewer`|`null`), `shareProject` upsert (re-share = idempotent role update), `getProjectById`, and a widened `listProjects` (owned ∪ shared, true `ownerId` preserved).
- **`POST /projects/:id/shares`** (owner-only) — resolves relationship first so an unrelated caller gets **404** (never revealing existence), a shared non-owner **403**; validates role (400), userId field (400), and user existence (404); returns `{projectId, userId, role}`.
- **Route gates** — viewers read-only (task writes → 403), editors read+write, only the owner deletes/shares. **Exports stay owner-scoped**; worker and admin CLI untouched.
- **README** endpoint table + role-semantics prose.

**Verification:** 26/26 tests pass (14 existing + 12 new covering AC-2…AC-11 plus cascade & upsert), typecheck clean, migrate idempotent. Acceptance self-eval (inline, per inline-dispatch routing) scored **11/11 met → proceed**. Close gates (typecheck/lint/format) all passed on re-run after a Biome format autofix.

One non-blocking degradation reported: the post-land `main` fast-forward was skipped because the main checkout is dirty (the untracked `temp/` dir) — the merge stands regardless.
